blocks.text: Crystal Dock provides the desktop dock and running-application indicators. Launch applications through their managed desktop entries. Dock presentation depends on the selected host layout and theme.

Managed appearance lives under ~/.config/crystal-dock/labwc/appearance.conf. Use Desktop Appearance for supported sizing and style controls. Restart Dock in the desktop settings menu uses the owning user service.

Save work, inspect the service status and recent user logs, then use the existing Restart Dock action once if appropriate. Avoid starting a second dock process manually; process ownership belongs to the session service.
